description: Boston Scientific Corporation is a global developer, manufacturer and marketer of medical devices used in a broad range of interventional medical specialties, and a medical technology leader for more than 45 years that has advanced the practice of less-invasive medicine by helping physicians and other medical professionals diagnose and treat a wide range of diseases and medical conditions and improve patients' quality of life by providing alternatives to surgery and other medical procedures that are typically traumatic to the body. Its mission is to transform lives through innovative medical solutions that improve the health of patients around the world, it advances science for life by providing high-performance solutions to address unmet patient needs and reduce the cost of health care, and it operates pursuant to five strategic imperatives, with businesses including Cardiovascular and Interventional Cardiology and Vascular Therapies, which develops and manufactures technologies to diagnose and treat complex coronary, peripheral and venous diseases.
